# Wintun

This directory contains the AMD64 `wintun.dll` from the official Wintun
0.14.1 binary distribution:

- Project: https://www.wintun.net/
- Archive: https://www.wintun.net/builds/wintun-0.14.1.zip
- Official archive SHA-256:
  `07c256185d6ee3652e09fa55c0b673e2624b565e02c4b9091c79ca7d2f24ef51`
- Bundled DLL SHA-256:
  `e5da8447dc2c320edc0fc52fa01885c103de8c118481f683643cacc3220dafce`
- Architecture: AMD64

`LICENSE.txt` is copied unchanged from the official archive. Windows release
artifacts include both the DLL and its license.
